svg.title: A request through the application gateway
svg.desc: A tunnel client resolves app.lab41.internal to agw-hub's private frontend. Plain HTTP on listener-http gets a permanent redirect to HTTPS; listener-https terminates TLS with cert-app from the key vault, then the WAF policy waf-hub, in Prevention mode, returns 403 to anything the Default Rule Set 2.1 or the custom rule BlockAttackQuery (attack=1 in the query string) matches. Other requests go to both VMs on port 80, and every response gets X-Lab: 41 and loses its Server header.
